questions.question: If x + y + z = 5, (1)/(x)+(1)/(y)+(1)/(z)=0, xyz = 12, and x³ + y³ + z³ = 151 then the value of (x² + y² + z²) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x + y + z = 5 

 (1)/(x)+(1)/(y)+(1)/(z)=0

xyz = 12

x3 + y3 + z3 = 151

**Formulas used:**

If x + y + z ≠ 0, (x³ + y³ + z³) - 3xyz = (x + y + z)(x2 + y2 + z2 - xy - yz - zx) 

(x + y + z)² = x² + y² + z² + 2(xy + yz + zx)

**Calculation:**

** (1)/(x)+(1)/(y)+(1)/(z)=0 **

⇒ (yz + zx + xy)/xyz = 0

⇒ (xy + yz + zx) = 0 (1) 

By using the formula, (x3 + y3 + z3) - 3xyz = (x + y + z)(x2 + y2 + z2 - xy - yz - zx) 

⇒ 151 - 3 × 12 = 5 × (x2 + y2 + z2 - 0) ∵ (xy + yz + zx) = 0 

⇒ 115/5 = x2 + y2 + z2 

**∴ x2 + y2 + z2 = 23**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **__Mistake Points__**By using the formula, (x + y + z)2 = x2 + y2 + z2 + 2(xy + yz + zx)

⇒ (5)² = x2 + y2 + z2 + 2 × 0 (From 1)

⇒ 25 - 0 = x2 + y2 + z2

**∴ x2 + y2 + z2 = 25**

**Note: The data given in the question give two possible answers by using different identities. **

**Therefore care must be taken while choosing the correct option as ****SSC CHSL**** takes 25 too as the right answer. **

questions.question: In a class, 60% of the students are girls and the rest are boys. 45% of the girls pass an examination and 40% of the boys failed. If the number of girls who failed is 66, the number of boys who passed the examination is:

Failed girls = (100 − 45)% of 60x = 55% of 60x = 33x.

**∴ The correct answer is 48 boys.**

In 2019, if 20% of the 'Other' category was Anjeer flavor and 4082 people preferred Anjeer flavor, then how many people were surveyed?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Percentage of popularity of 'Other' category = 15.7% 

Percentage of popularity of Anjeer flavour out of 'Other' = 20% 

No of people liking Anjeer flavour = 4082 

**Calculation: **

Let the no of people surveyed = y 

As per the question;

⇒ y × 15.7% = 'Other' category 

No of people liking Anjeer flavour = 4082 

⇒ (y × 15.7%) × 20% = 4082 

⇒ y × 157/1000 × 20/100 = 4082 

⇒ y × 157/1000 × 1/5 = 4082 

⇒ y = (4082 × 1000 × 5)/157

⇒ y = 130000 

**∴ The no of people surveyed was 130000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**By unitary method:

20% = 4082

⇒ 1% = 4082/20

The number of people liking other = 100%

⇒ 100 × (4082/20)

⇒ 20410

Now, according to the pie chart,

15.7% of the total is 20410.

⇒ 15.7% = 20410

⇒ 1% = 20410/15.7

⇒ 100% = (20410/15.7) × 100

⇒ 130000

∴ The no of people surveyed was 130000.

questions.question: Rakesh sold a car for Rs.5,00,000 at a 28% profit. At what price should he sell it to get a 32% profit?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **Selling Prices** = (100 + Profit₁) : (100 + Profit₂)

Ratio = (100 + 28) : (100 + 32) = 128 : 132 = **32 : 33**

Given 32 units = Rs. 5,00,000

New Selling Price = (5,00,000 ÷ 32) × 33 = 15,625 × 33 = Rs. 5,15,625

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 5,15,625.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** First Selling Price (SP₁) = Rs. 5,00,000, Profit₁ = 28%, Profit₂ = 32%

**Formula Used:** Cost Price (CP) = [SP × 100] / [100 + Profit%]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c81b22f55316dabe8322de0936231557b2bd5864cfa39bfb2a4684fa41e971c4.png] 

⇒ CP = (5,00,000 × 100) ÷ (100 + 28)

⇒ CP = 5,00,00,000 ÷ 128 = Rs. 3,90,625

⇒ New Selling Price = CP × (100 + 32) ÷ 100

⇒ New Selling Price = 3,90,625 × (132 ÷ 100)

⇒ New Selling Price = 3,90,625 × 1.32 = Rs. 5,15,625

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 5,15,625.**

**__Additional Information__**

Profit and Loss Basic Relation

Profit % = [(SP − CP) ÷ CP] × 100. Always calculate profit or loss percentage on the **Cost Price** unless stated otherwise.

Direct SP Comparison

When CP is constant: SP₁ ÷ (100 ± P/L₁) = SP₂ ÷ (100 ± P/L₂). This allows solving without calculating the actual CP.

Marked Price and Discount

SP = Marked Price × (100 − Discount%) ÷ 100. Profit can also be expressed as CP × (100 + Profit%) ÷ 100.</p

questions.question: If the ratio of the curved surface area and volume of a right circular cylinder is 5 ∶ 7, then its radius is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ratio of the curved surface area and volume of a right circular cylinder = 5 ∶ 7

**Formulas used:**

Curved surface area of cylinder = 2πrh 

Volume of the cylinder = πr²h

**Calculation:**

2πrh/πr2h = 5/7 

⇒ 2/r = 5/7 

⇒ 2/r = 5/7

⇒ r = 14/5 = 2.8 units 

**∴ The radius of the cylinder is 2.8 units. **

questions.question: AB is a diameter of a circle with centre O. If C is any point on the circle such that ∠BAC = 42°, then find the measure of ∠BOC.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Diameter = AB 

∠BAC = 42°

**Concept:**

Angle in a semi-circle is a right angle. 

The Sum of all the angles in a triangle is 180°. 

Angles opposite to equal sides are equal in measure. 

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a0fa78118ce45d1c60b7424c314c7d8746569ccef0bda4c49f39f2422712d257.png] 

In triangle ABC, ∠A + ∠B + ∠C = 180° [Angle sum property]

⇒ 42° + ∠B + 90° = 180° [Angle in a semi-circle is 90°] 

⇒ ∠B = 180° - 90°- 42° = 48° 

In triangle BOC, ∠OBC + ∠BOC + ∠BCO = 180°

⇒ 48° + 48° + ∠BOC = 180° [Angles opposite to equal sides are equal] 

⇒ ∠BOC = 180° - 48° - 48° [ BO = CO = r] 

**∴ ∠BOC = 84° **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__** The angle made on the center by a chord is double the angle made on the circumference by the same chord.

∠BOC = 2∠BAC = 2 × 42° 

⇒ 84° 

∴ The required angle is 84°.

questions.question: A man invested a total of Rs.12,050 in two parts, one at 10% p.a. simple interest for 2 years and the other at the same rate at compound interest, interest being compounded annually, for the same time. The amounts he received from both the parts are equal. The sum (in Rs.) invested at the compound interest is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total investment = Rs.12050

Rate of interest = 10% 

Time = 2 years 

**Formulas used:**

Simple Interest = Principal × Time × Rate/100 

Amount = Principal + Simple Interest 

In Compound Interest; Amount = Principal × (1 + R/100)ⁿ

**Calculation:**

Let the sum invested at compound interest be = y 

⇒ Sum invested at simple interest = 12050 - y 

As per the question;

(12050 - y) + (12050 - y) × 10/100 × 2 = y × (1 + 10/100)²

⇒ (12050 - y) [1 + 1/5] = y × 11/10 × 11/10 

⇒ (12050 - y) × 6/5 = y × 121/100 

⇒ 12050 × 6/5 - y × 6/5 = y × 121/100 

⇒14460 = 121y/100 + 6y/5

⇒ 14460 = (121y + 120y)/100 

⇒ 14460 = 241y/100 

⇒y = (14460 × 100)/241 

⇒ y = 6000 

**∴ The sum invested on compound interest is Rs.6000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**Equivalent rate of interest in the case of CI 

⇒ 10 + 10 + (10 × 10)/100 = 21%

Let a and b be the sum invested on SI and CI.

a + (a × 2 × 10)/100 = b + (b × 21)/100

⇒ a/b = 121/120

(121 + 120) units = 12050

⇒ 241 units = 12050

⇒ 1 unit = 12050/241 = 50

The sum invested on CI = 120 units = 50 × 120

⇒ Rs. 6000

 The sum invested on compound interest is Rs.6000.

questions.question: The list price of a motorcycle is 20% more than its cost price. It is sold at a discount of 30%. Find the dealer's loss percentage.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**CP ∶ MP = 100 ∶ 120 = 5 ∶ 6

SP after 30% discount = 6 × 0.7 = 4.2

Loss% = [(5 - 4.2)/5] × 100

⇒ 80/5 = 16%

**∴ The loss% is 16%.**

**Given:**

List Price of motorcycle = 20% more than Cost Price

Discount = 30%

**Formulas used:**

List Price = Cost Price × (100 + Mark up)%

Selling Price = List Price × (100 - Discount)%

Loss = Cost Price - Selling Price 

Loss percentage = Loss/Cost Price × 100 

**Calculation:**

Let the Cost Price of motorcycle be = 100a 

⇒ List Price = 100a × (100% + 20%) 

⇒ List Price = 100a × 120/100 = 120a (1) 

Selling Price = 120a × (100% - 30%) 

⇒ Selling Price = 120a × 70/100 = 84a 

Loss = Cost Price - Selling Price 

⇒ Loss = 100a - 84a = 16a 

Loss Percentage = 16a/100a × 100 

⇒ Loss Percentage = 16%

**∴ Dealer's loss percentage is 16%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**By Ratio Method

List Price is calculated on Cost Price.

Mark up percentage = 20% = 1/5 

Discount is calculated on List Price. 

Discount percentage = 30% = 3/10 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31bda22d3b6d097e54bf7bf202fa6f6e1064d600fd33011a397f78557db6aa38.png] 

**∴ Dealer's loss percentage = 4/25 × 100 = 16%**

questions.question: The present ages of A and B are in the ratio 9 ∶ 10. The ratio of their ages 8 years from now will be 11 ∶ 12. What will be the sum of their ages (in years) after 3 years from now?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Present Ratio (**A : B**) = 9 : 10 (Difference = 1 unit)

Future Ratio (8 years later) = 11 : 12 (Difference = 1 unit)

Increase in ratio = 11 − 9 = 2 units (which corresponds to 8 years)

⇒ 2 units = 8 years ⇒ 1 unit = 4 years

Sum of present ages = (9 + 10) × 4 = 76 years

Sum after 3 years = 76 + (2 × 3) = 82 years

**∴ The correct answer is 82 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/789f09dc173ce51720f13be09b75a15a5032afea762106ee5022f5a9aeb68155.png] 

**Given:** Present ages of **A** and **B** are in ratio **9 : 10**. Let their ages be **9x** and **10x**.

**Formula:** Ratio = Age₁ / Age₂

⇒ (9x + 8) / (10x + 8) = 11 / 12

⇒ 12 × (9x + 8) = 11 × (10x + 8)

⇒ 108x + 96 = 110x + 88

⇒ 110x − 108x = 96 − 88

⇒ 2x = 8 ⇒ x = 4

⇒ Present age of A = 9 × 4 = 36 years

⇒ Present age of B = 10 × 4 = 40 years

⇒ Sum of ages after 3 years = (36 + 3) + (40 + 3) = 39 + 43 = 82 years

**∴ The correct answer is 82 years.**

Ratio Difference Method

If the difference between ratio terms is constant (e.g., 10-9=1 and 12-11=1), the change in units is directly proportional to the change in years.

Age Gap Consistency

The numerical difference between the ages of two persons remains **constant** throughout their lives, regardless of the years passed.

Sum of Ages Change

When calculating the sum of ages for 'n' people after 't' years, the sum increases by **n × t** years.</p
